notes.general_comments:
There was a very good spread of scores. Fifteen questions were answered correctly by 75% or more of
candidates – Questions 4, 6, 7, 11, 12, 13, 14, 16, 23, 29, 31, 36, 37, 39 and 40. Questions 21, 22, 27, 30
and 33 proved to be more difficult, with fewer than half of the candidates answering them correctly.
